solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Exercise covers getting more on station

indicators.note: covers says the exercise letters wrap around the next piece

parts.note: PT is physical training, exercise
adding is getting more of something
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone's workout routine hides them in extra layers on the way to a railway platform.
explanation.walkthrough: PADDINGTON is a major London railway terminus.
explanation.definitionFit: A well-known London rail terminus, so an example of a station.

clue.text: Land according to turn

parts.note: per means according to, as in per instructions
a U-turn, so U stands for a turn

explanation.surface: A pilot told to come round according to instructions before landing.
explanation.definitionFit: A South American country, so an example of a land or nation.

clue.text: Worth tidying mess

indicators.note: a mess is a jumbled state, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Someone sees the value in cleaning up a mess.
explanation.definitionFit: Dignity is a sense of self-worth and being worthy of respect.

clue.text: Obstruction is about money

indicators.note: about says the word is wraps round the currency word

parts.note: taken as written
the leu is the currency unit of Romania and Moldova

explanation.surface: A blockage turns out to be all about cash.
explanation.walkthrough: ILEUS is a medical term for a blockage of the intestine.
explanation.definitionFit: An ileus is an intestinal blockage, a medical obstruction of the bowel.

clue.text: Plots to scrap uprising and retreats

indicators.note: uprising in a down clue says the scrap word reads from the bottom up

parts.note: a rag is a scrap of cloth
dens are private retreats or hideaways

explanation.surface: Conspirators plan to call off a revolt and pull back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plots' and 'uprising' suggest conspiracy; plots are pieces of ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Garden plots are pieces of cultivated ground, so plots for growing things are gardens.

clue.text: Place of learning turned us down for discharge

parts.note: OU is the Open University

indicators.note: turned says the newspaper letters are read backwards

parts.note: the Financial Times, the paper setting the puzzle, is FT
low means feeling down

explanation.surface: A college rejected an applicant for some leak or emission.
explanation.walkthrough: 'us' is the newspaper itself, the FT; 'turned' makes TF. The Open University is a British distance-learning university.
explanation.definitionFit: An outflow is a flowing out, as of liquid or money, which is a discharge.

clue.text: Suffer being spectacled, maybe

definitions.meaning: to suffer something is to put up with or endure it
the spectacled ... of the Andes is one kind, named for the pale rings round its eyes

explanation.surface: Someone moans that wearing glasses is a hardship.
explanation.definitionFit: Endure is a synonym; and the spectacled is a South American species of the animal.

clue.text: Hacks at top of perm leaving misreported mess

indicators.note: leaving says the letters of the word perm are taken out of the jumble
mess says the remaining letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Journalists at the top complain that a hairdo was botched in the reports.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the letters of PERM out of MISREPORTED ('leaving'), then rearrange what remains ('mess').
explanation.definitionFit: Hacks are journalists; those at the top of a paper are its chief journalists who run it.

clue.text: Records Bognor perhaps with essays

parts.note: Bognor Regis is a seaside town, so Regis can follow Bognor (as with Lyme Regis)
an essay is an attempt, a try

explanation.surface: Records of a seaside town compiled with school compositions.
explanation.walkthrough: Bognor Regis is a seaside resort in West Sussex, England. 'essays' looks like school writing; here it means attempts.
explanation.definitionFit: Registries are offices where official lists are held, so they keep records.

clue.text: Right to cry out before One Direction entered university

indicators.note: before says the first group comes ahead of the second
to and out wrap around right, so the right letter is put into the cry word
out completes the frame: cry ... out surrounds the right letter

parts.note: to sob is to cry

indicators.note: entered says the compass letter goes inside the word one

parts.note: taken as written
N, north, is a compass direction

explanation.surface: A boy band fan cries out on behalf of One Direction's arrival at college.
explanation.walkthrough: R goes into SOB ('to ... out' wrapping it), and N goes into ONE ('entered'). One Direction is a boy band. The Sorbonne is in Paris.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sorbonne is the historic university in Paris, so an example of a university.

clue.text: Heel of topless shoe

indicators.note: topless says the first letter of the shoe word is lopped off

parts.note: a brogue is a sturdy decorated leather shoe

explanation.surface: Talk of the heel of a shoe that has lost its upper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heel' looks like part of the shoe, but it is the definition: a heel is a cad.
explanation.definitionFit: A heel is a dishonourable man, a scoundrel or rascal, exactly a rogue.

clue.text: Call round at ten with new restriction on what we eat

indicators.note: round says the call word goes around the other pieces

parts.note: to ring someone is to call them on the phone
taken as written
IO looks like the figures 1 and 0, ten

explanation.surface: A phone call at ten o'clock brings news of a new limit on food.
explanation.walkthrough: IO for ten is a crossword convention: the letters resemble the digits 10.
explanation.definitionFit: Rationing limits the amount of food each person may have, as in wartime Britain.

clue.text: What poor witch may do to display bad character?

definitions.meaning: a poor witch might fail to cast an incantation properly
a character is a letter, so to show a bad one is to write a word wrongly

explanation.surface: A question about how an incompetent witch might show off her wicked nature.
explanation.walkthrough: Both halves are cryptic: a 'miss' of a 'spell', and 'character' meaning a written letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Writing a wrong letter is mis-spelling; a witch whose charm fails has a miss with her charm.

clue.text: Starts fires

definitions.meaning: to boot a computer is to start it up
to give someone the boot is to dismiss them from work

explanation.definitionFit: Both are verb senses: starting up a computer and kicking out or sacking an employee.

clue.text: Arrangement to cut off deal for personal cover

indicators.note: an arrangement sets things in a new order, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A negotiator moves to end a deal over personal insurance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'personal cover' sounds like insurance, but it is clothing: a hooded toggle-fastened coat.
explanation.definitionFit: A coat covers its wearer, and this hooded woollen one with toggles is a garment.

clue.text: Grant could be for returning hero

definitions.meaning: ... S. Grant was the American general and president
Odysseus, in Latin form, is the hero whose voyage home is the story of the Odyssey

explanation.surface: A subsidy might be given for a war veteran coming home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grant' looks like money; it is the US president, whose first name this is.
explanation.definitionFit: The first name of General Grant, and the Latin name of Homer's hero who journeys home from Troy.

clue.text: Possibly carry on with fit specimen

parts.note: to suit is to fit or be right for
a case is an instance or specimen of something

explanation.surface: Perhaps continue with a healthy example.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carry on' looks like a verb but is the cabin bag taken onto a plane.
explanation.definitionFit: Hand luggage taken aboard a plane is a carry-on, and a small one of these can be one.

clue.text: Green family tie knot

definitions.meaning: ... green is a shade of the colour
the British royal family took this surname in 1917
a broad symmetrical knot for a necktie

explanation.surface: An environmentalist clan fastening their neckwear.
explanation.walkthrough: A triple definition; the surface reads 'Green family' together.
explanation.definitionFit: The British royal house's name, a necktie knot style, and a named shade of green paint.

clue.text: Finish off bird on fire

indicators.note: finish off says the last letter of the bird word is cut away

parts.note: a flamingo is a pink wading bird

explanation.surface: An instruction to kill a bird that is already burning.
explanation.definitionFit: Something burning with flames, ablaze, is aflame.

clue.text: He's unconvinced that he is taking part

indicators.note: part says a portion of the words that he is taking gives the letters

explanation.surface: Someone sceptical says he is taking part only reluctantly.
explanation.definitionFit: A non-believer is not convinced that any god exists.

clue.text: Take off close in poem — it's so long

parts.note: to take off is to leave, go

indicators.note: in says the nearby word sits inside the poem word

parts.note: an ode is a lyric poem
by means near or close, as in stand by

explanation.surface: Remove the ending from a poem because it is far too long.
explanation.walkthrough: 'so long' looks like length but is the farewell.
explanation.definitionFit: So long is an informal farewell, used for parting company.

clue.text: Unsettled by deliveries delayed until Easter initially

parts.note: in cricket an over is a set of six balls bowled, or deliveries

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of each of the three words before it

explanation.surface: Someone is upset that parcels will not arrive until Easter.
explanation.walkthrough: An OVER is a cricket term: six balls bowled in a row by one bowler.
explanation.definitionFit: An unsettled bill is unpaid, and so late in being paid.

clue.text: Leading part in Porridge?

parts.note: Porridge is a British prison sitcom; a leading part is the star role, but in the dish the main ingredient is ground oats

explanation.walkthrough: Porridge was a BBC prison sitcom starring Ronnie Barker; the capital letter disguises the breakfast dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Porridge is made chiefly from ground oats, its main ingredient playing the starring role.

clue.text: Most gloomy braves hold end of tomahawk with a bit of trepidation

indicators.note: with says the trepidation letter is added on
hold says the dares word keeps the tomahawk letter within

parts.note: to brave something is to dare it

indicators.note: end of takes the closing letter of tomahawk
a bit of takes just the opening letter of trepidation

explanation.surface: Native American braves grip a tomahawk with some fear, in the bleakest of moods.
explanation.definitionFit: Darkest is the superlative of dark, meaning gloomiest or most sombre.

clue.text: Values some Elizabeth I coins

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A collector describes some Tudor money from the reign of Elizabeth I.
explanation.definitionFit: A set of moral principles is a person's values; the singular is used for a code of conduct.

clue.text: Sea trout floundering face down

indicators.note: floundering means thrashing about in confusion, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A fish struggles, lying with its face on the seabed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Floundering' is apt for fish but signals the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: To face someone down is to stare them into submission, defeating them by gaze.

clue.text: Number of commandments describing approval for remembrance

indicators.note: describing in the sense of drawing a line around, so the number word encircles

parts.note: there are ten commandments
OK is a word of approval

explanation.surface: The commandments are recalled with approval in memory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'describing' is used in its geometric sense: to describe a circle is to draw around.
explanation.definitionFit: A keepsake or memento given to be remembered by is a token of remembrance.

clue.text: Design most of factory

indicators.note: most of says the factory word loses its last letter

parts.note: a plant is an industrial works, a factory

explanation.surface: The design is for most of a factory.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan is a design or drawing for something to be built.

clue.text: Duck born inside shell, say, may be forgotten

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of zero, O

indicators.note: inside says the born letter sits within the projectile word

parts.note: a shell is one example of a missile

explanation.surface: A duckling hatching inside its egg might be overlooked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shell' suggests an egg, but it is an artillery shell, a missile.
explanation.definitionFit: Something omissible can be left out, so it may be omitted or forgotten without loss.

clue.text: Prepare to pray for king born at finishing school

parts.note: K is the chess and card abbreviation for king
née, French for born, introduces a maiden name

indicators.note: finishing picks the closing letter of the word school

explanation.surface: A monarch educated at a finishing school gets ready for prayers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Finishing school' reads as a place of polish, but finishing takes the last letter of school.
explanation.definitionFit: Going down on one's knees is how many people get into position for prayer.

clue.text: Disapprove of posh prelate

parts.note: to tut at something is to make a disapproving click of the tongue
U means upper-class, the opposite of non-U

explanation.surface: Someone frowns on a grand senior clergyman.
explanation.walkthrough: U for upper-class is a convention from the 1950s U/non-U debate.
explanation.definitionFit: Desmond Tutu was Archbishop of Cape Town, a senior bishop or prelate.

clue.text: Dish of beef wound round fish covering

indicators.note: round says the injury word goes around the fish word

parts.note: a welt is a raised mark on skin from a blow, a wound
a ling is a long cod-like sea fish
on means lying over or covering something

explanation.surface: A beef dish rolled around a fish coating, like a surf-and-turf recipe.
explanation.definitionFit: Beef Wellington is fillet steak baked in a pastry crust, a classic named dish.
